title: Add Rental, Home Delivery, and Authorized Dealer Highlights

requirements.summary: Add a 'Machines Available on Rent' section to the HomePage highlighting rental availability for agricultural machines
acceptanceCriteria: A rental section/card is visible on the HomePage
The section clearly communicates that machines are available for rent
A contact link or call-to-action is present for rental inquiries

file_operations.description: Add a 'Machines Available on Rent' section after the hero section and before the featured products. Include a visually distinct card with a heading, short description explaining rental availability for agricultural equipment, and a contact call-to-action button that links to the business contact information. Use earthy-green styling consistent with the existing theme.

requirements.summary: Add 'Home Delivery Available' badge or highlight across HomePage hero, ProductCatalogPage, and Footer
acceptanceCriteria: Home delivery information is visible on the HomePage
Home delivery information is visible on the ProductCatalogPage
The Footer includes a mention of home delivery
A delivery icon or badge accompanies the text

file_operations.description: Add a 'Home Delivery Available' badge to the hero section using the generated image at frontend/public/assets/generated/home-delivery-icon.dim_128x128.png. Display the icon alongside text 'Home Delivery Available' in a prominent position within the hero area, styled with earthy-green tones.

Add a 'Home Delivery Available' badge near the page title or header area using the generated image at frontend/public/assets/generated/home-delivery-icon.dim_128x128.png. Include the delivery icon with text 'Home Delivery Available' to make it prominent for users browsing products.

Add a 'Home Delivery Available' mention in the contact section of the footer using the generated image at frontend/public/assets/generated/home-delivery-icon.dim_128x128.png. Display the delivery icon with text to reinforce delivery availability site-wide.

requirements.summary: Add 'Authorized Dealer of Srachi in Kashmir Province' highlight to HomePage hero and BusinessProfilePage
acceptanceCriteria: The authorized dealer badge/seal is displayed on the HomePage hero section
The authorized dealer information is also present on the BusinessProfilePage
The badge clearly names Srachi and Kashmir Province

file_operations.description: Add an 'Authorized Dealer – Srachi, Kashmir Province' badge to the hero section using the generated image at frontend/public/assets/generated/srachi-dealer-badge.dim_300x120.png. Display the trust seal prominently near the hero content to establish dealer credibility.

Add an 'Authorized Dealer – Srachi, Kashmir Province' badge to the business profile page using the generated image at frontend/public/assets/generated/srachi-dealer-badge.dim_300x120.png. Display the trust seal in a prominent position alongside other business credentials to reinforce authorized dealer status.

requirements.summary: Update ProductCard component to display 'Available for Rent' badge for rental availability
acceptanceCriteria: Product cards show a rental availability indicator
The indicator is visually distinct from other badges

file_operations.description: Add an 'Available for Rent' badge to the ProductCard component that displays alongside existing price and availability information. Since the backend does not currently support a rental flag on products, display the rental availability note on all product cards. Style the badge distinctly using earthy-green tones to differentiate it from category and availability badges.
